info.title: omega
info.description: Web interface to a local omp coding agent. Every path and schema in this document was derived from the TypeScript declarations in src/shared by the wiz plugin.

post.summary: Open or create a live session
post.description:
Load a session as a live agent, or start a new one in `cwd`.

Idempotent for an already-loaded session: the existing live agent is
returned rather than a second one being created for the same file.

get.description: Current model, thinking level, streaming status and plan state.

One page of the session transcript, flattened into renderable parts.

The newest `limit` messages by default; `before` walks backwards through
older history. Thinking and tool parts are dropped server-side when the
client says it will not draw them.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description:
Newest messages to return. Defaults to 1000, which is what one page of
this UI renders without virtualisation.

Older history is read by asking for a larger window rather than by
walking a cursor: the window is the whole tail of the conversation, so
one request describes what is on screen and a reload reproduces it.

parameters.name: thinking
parameters.description: Include the agent's thinking blocks. Default true.

parameters.name: toolCalls
parameters.description: Include tool calls and their results. Default true.

Restart the conversation from an earlier user message: omp writes a new
session containing everything up to that message's parent and continues
there, returning the message text so the composer can be pre-filled.

The plan document, its headings and the executable role tiers — the three

post.description:
Resolve the plan review: approve and execute, approve and compact,
approve into a fresh session, or refine with feedback.

Render markdown with `Bun.markdown.html`.

The browser has no `Bun.markdown`, so every rendering in the UI —
transcript text, thinking blocks, the plan document — comes from here.

Workspace.description: A directory that has at least one omp session on disk.

cwd.description: Absolute working directory the sessions were started in.

sessions.description: Sessions started in this directory, newest first.

exists.description: True when the directory still exists on disk.

SessionSummary.description: One persisted session, as listed from disk without loading its transcript.

path.description: Absolute path of the `.jsonl` session file.

title.description: Generated or user-set session title; absent for untitled sessions.

firstMessage.description: First user message, truncated for preview.

live.description: True when this session is currently loaded as a live agent in the server.

SessionStatus.description:
Coarse lifecycle status of a persisted session, mirroring omp's own
`SessionStatus` union so the badge in the UI means what omp means.

ActiveSessionOverview.description: Detailed snapshot of an active live session for the multi-session overview.

ThinkingLevel.description: omp thinking levels, in ascending order of budget.

RateLimitState.description: Rate limit details when a session has hit provider limits.

ModelOption.description: A model the local omp install is authenticated for.

ref.description: `provider/id`, the stable value used by the selector.

reasoning.description: True when the model supports a thinking/reasoning budget.

content.description: Text content for readable text/code files.

isTooLarge.description: True when file exceeds inline preview threshold (500 KB).

clean.description: True when no tracked or untracked changes exist.

files.description: Map of relative file paths to their git status.

GitFileStatus.description: Git change classification for a single workspace file.

path.description: Normalized relative file path in the workspace.

marker.description: Single-character marker (e.g. M, U, A, D, R, C, !).

staged.description: True if change has staged modifications in the index.

unstaged.description: True if change has unstaged modifications in the working tree.

hasDiff.description: True if diff output is non-empty.

isBinary.description: True if file or diff is binary.

isTooLarge.description: True when diff exceeds preview threshold (500 KB).

OpenSessionRequest.description: Which session to load as a live agent.

sessionPath.description: Absolute `.jsonl` path of an existing session. Omit to start a new one.

cwd.description: Working directory for a new session. Required when `sessionPath` is absent.

LiveState.description: Everything the chat header and composer need about a live session.

key.description:
omp session UUID — the key for every other session route. A UUID rather
than the session's file path so it needs no escaping in a path segment.

sessionFile.description: Absolute path of the `.jsonl` session file backing this session.

streaming.description: True while a turn is in flight.

queued.description: Messages queued behind the active turn.

plan.description: Plan mode state, when plan mode is enabled.

todos.description: Phases and tasks tracked by the session's todo tool.

subagents.description: Sub-agent tasks spawned during this session.

lastError.description:
Why the last turn stopped without finishing, if it did.

The socket reports a failure once, to whoever is listening at the time.
A reload is a new listener, so the reason has to live somewhere a fresh
page can ask for it — otherwise the conversation simply stops mid-turn
and the UI has nothing to say about why. Cleared when the next turn
starts.

ContextUsage.description: Context-window consumption for the live session.

PlanState.description: Plan-mode status carried alongside live session state.

awaitingApproval.description: True once a plan has been submitted for review via `xd://propose`.

title.description: Resolved plan title, present once proposed.

TodoPhase.description: A logical grouping of tasks in the todo list.

blocker.description: Note explaining what the task is blocked on.

TodoTaskStatus.description: Lifecycle status of a task in the todo list.

SubagentTask.description: A subagent task spawned by the session.

SubagentStatus.description: Lifecycle status of a spawned subagent.

Transcript.description: A transcript window: the newest `limit` messages, and whether older exist.

hasMore.description: True when messages older than the first one here were left out.

TranscriptMessage.description: A transcript entry, flattened for rendering.

id.description: Render key, unique within a transcript.

timestamp.description: ISO-8601, when the entry carried one.

entryId.description:
The omp session entry this message was written as.

Present on persisted user messages, which are the only entries omp will
branch from. Absent on assistant messages, on anything still streaming,
and on the local echo of a message the server has not stored yet — so its
presence is exactly the test for whether a branch can start here.

text.description: Markdown source for `text`/`thinking`, rendered output for tool parts.

toolCallId.description: omp tool call id, correlating a call with its result.

PromptRequest.description: A message to send to the agent.

deliverAs.description:
How to deliver while a turn is already streaming. `steer` interrupts,
`followUp` queues for after the turn. Ignored when the session is idle.

idempotencyKey.description:
Client-generated id for this send, used to make delivery exactly-once.

The browser keeps an outbox so a message typed with no network survives
a closed tab, which makes retries inevitable: a send can succeed after
the outbox snapshot that still lists it, and be replayed by whoever
restores that snapshot. The server remembers recent ids per session and
answers a repeat without prompting the agent again, so "retry until it
lands" cannot turn into the same message twice.

Attachment.description:
A file sent along with a message.

omp takes images as a first-class attachment, so those reach the model as
images. It has no channel for anything else, so a text file is inlined into
the message instead, and a binary one is refused rather than turned into a
wall of base64 nobody can read.

mimeType.description: IANA type as the browser reported it, e.g. `image/png`, `text/plain`.

data.description: File bytes, base64, without a `data:` prefix.

Ack.description: An operation that reports only success.

detail.description: Human-readable detail, for surfacing in a notification.

sessionKey.description:
Session the caller should switch to. Set by the `execute` plan action,
which runs the approved plan in a fresh session.

BtwRequest.description: Ask a transient side question without polluting session history.

BtwResult.description: Answer to an ephemeral side question.

OmfgAnalyzeRequest.description: Analyze a mistake from the previous turn and synthesize a TTSR rule.

OmfgSaveRequest.description: Save a generated rule into project or global rules directory.

A2uiDismissRequest.description: Dismiss an A2UI surface from the session.

QueuedMessage.description: A user message waiting its turn.

index.description: Position among the user messages of its lane, oldest first.

QueueLane.description:
Which queue a message waits in.

`steer` messages interrupt the turn at its next step; `followUp` messages
wait for it to finish. omp keeps them as two ordered lanes, and a message
cannot move between them without being re-sent.

SlashCommand.description:
A slash command an MCP server contributes to this session.

These are omp's own: a connected server publishes prompts, omp turns each
into a `/name` command, and expands it when a message starting with that
name is sent. Nothing here executes anything — the list exists so the
palette can show what the session actually has, rather than leaving it to
be discovered by guessing.

name.description: Command word without its leading slash, e.g. `github:review`.

description.description: One-line description, as the server published it.

McpServerInfo.description: Information about a configured MCP server.

TestMcpServerRequest.description: Test connection to an MCP server.

TestMcpServerResult.description: Outcome of testing an MCP server connection.

ListToolsResult.description: List of tools available to the session.

SessionToolInfo.description: Information about a tool registered in the session.

ToolSource.description: Source category of an available tool.

ForceToolRequest.description: Force or clear tool choice for the next turn.

SessionRuleInfo.description: Information about a discovered stream rule (TTSR).

RuleScopeType.description: Scope level of a TTSR rule.

AddMcpServerRequest.description: Add or update an MCP server.

ToggleMcpServerRequest.description: Toggle an MCP server enabled/disabled state.

MutateTodosRequest.description: Request to mutate the session's todo list.

TodoMutationAction.description: Action to perform when mutating the todo list.

ListJobsResult.description: List of running and recently settled background jobs.

SessionAsyncJob.description: An asynchronous background job owned by the session.

ListProcessesResult.description: List of supervised processes in the workspace.

ManagedProcessInfo.description: Information about a supervised background process in the workspace.

SignalProcessRequest.description: Send a signal to a supervised process.

ProcessActionRequest.description: Stop or restart a supervised process.

QueueEditRequest.description:
Rewrite one queued message.

`expected` is the text the client last saw at this position. The agent
drains the queue on its own schedule, so a position alone is not a safe
handle: if the text no longer matches, the queue moved and the edit is
refused rather than applied to whatever slid into the slot.

QueueDropRequest.description: Drop one queued message before it is ever delivered.

SelectModelRequest.description: Model to switch the live session to.

mode.description: Omitted uses the session's configured method order.

focus.description: Free-text focus for the summary. Rejected with `snapcompact`, which writes no summary.

ShakeMode.description: Which heavy content to drop from context.

ThinkingRequest.description: Thinking level for the live session.

RenameRequest.description: A new display name for the session.

BranchPoint.description: A user message a branch can start from.

entryId.description: omp entry id of the user message.

text.description: Message preview, truncated for the picker.

BranchResult.description: A branch: the re-keyed session plus the message text to re-edit.

draft.description: Full text of the message branched from, for pre-filling the composer.

PlanDocument.description: The plan document plus everything the three planning panes render.

content.description: Raw markdown source, empty when the agent has not written a plan yet.

tiers.description: Role tiers the plan may be executed with, for the actions panel.

keepContextDisabled.description:
True when approving with the planning context intact would not fit the
model's context window. omp disables its keep-context option in exactly
this case, so the actions panel disables `keep` too.

PlanSection.description: One heading in the plan document, for the left-hand table of contents.

id.description: Stable slug, used as the scroll anchor id.

line.description: 0-based line offset of the heading within the plan source.

PlanTier.description: One configured role model the approved plan can be executed with.

PlanModeRequest.description: Whether plan mode should be on.

PlanActionRequest.description: A decision from the plan actions panel.

feedback.description:
Section annotations and free-text notes re-prompted to the model.
Required by `refine`, ignored otherwise.

tier.description: Role tier to execute the approved plan with; defaults to `default`.

PlanAction.description:
The four decisions omp's plan review offers, matching the option list in
`InteractiveMode.handlePlanApproval` one-for-one.

- `execute` — "Approve and execute": `preserveContext: false`, so execution
  starts from a fresh context seeded with the plan artifact.
- `compact` — "Approve and compact context": distill the planning transcript,
  then execute.
- `keep` — "Approve and keep context": execute with the planning transcript
  intact. omp disables this when the context is already too full.
- `refine` — "Refine plan": stay in plan mode and re-prompt the model with
  `feedback`.

MarkdownRequest.description:
Markdown to render.

A batch rather than a single string: a transcript mounts hundreds of parts
at once, and one request per part is hundreds of round trips for work the
server does in microseconds.

RenderedMarkdown.description:
Rendered markdown, produced on the server by `Bun.markdown.react` and React
SSR. One entry per requested text, in request order.
